title: cleyera ternstroemioides
intro: Cleyera ternstroemioides, commonly known as Japanese evergreen holly or Cleyera, is a species of flowering plant in the family Pentaphylacaceae. It is a shrub or small tree native to Asia, valued for its ornamental and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Cleyera ternstroemioides include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce pain and prevent infections.
